name.en: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership
name.zh: 跨太平洋夥伴全面進步協定

headquarters.en: No permanent secretariat (rotating Commission chair; Viet Nam chairs in 2026)
headquarters.zh: 無常設秘書處（執委會主席輪值，2026年由越南擔任）

nature.en: High-standard plurilateral free trade agreement (treaty); signed 8 Mar 2018, in force 30 Dec 2018
nature.zh: 高標準的複邊自由貿易協定（條約）；2018年3月8日簽署，同年12月30日生效

purpose.en: Removes most tariffs and sets high common rules on services, investment, digital trade, state-owned enterprises, labour and environment among Pacific Rim (and now European) economies.
purpose.zh: 在環太平洋（及英國等）經濟體之間取消大部分關稅，並在服務、投資、數位貿易、國營企業、勞工與環境等領域制定高標準共同規則。

members.note: First new member via accession; in force 15 Dec 2024.
Applied Aug 2022; Accession Working Group launched Nov 2024; negotiations substantially concluded 6 May 2026; legal instrument of accession being finalised (not yet a party as of 2026-11-16).
Applied Dec 2022; accession process commenced at the 9th Commission (Melbourne, 21 Nov 2025); Accession Working Group active per Jun 2026 ministerial statement.
Applied 2024; selected Nov 2025 as in line with the Auckland Principles; 'preparatory discussions' agreed Jun 2026 (no Accession Working Group yet).
Applied Sep 2024; same stage as UAE (preparatory discussions, Jun 2026).
Applied Aug 2025; same stage as UAE (preparatory discussions, Jun 2026).
Applied 16 Sep 2021; no accession process launched.

members.official_name: Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu
members.note: Applied 22 Sep 2021 under this WTO-style name; no accession process launched.
Applied Dec 2021; no accession process launched.
Applied May 2023; no accession process launched.

acceding.zh: 入會談判中（已成立入會工作小組）

candidate.zh: 已申請加入（尚未成立工作小組）

notes: 12 parties: original 11 + UK (in force 15 Dec 2024). 'joined' = year the agreement entered into force for that party.
'acceding' = formal Accession Working Group: Costa Rica (negotiations substantially concluded 6 May 2026, still not a party) and Uruguay (process launched 21 Nov 2025).

'candidate' is used here (judgement call) for all other formal applicants, to make pending applications visible on the map: UAE, Indonesia, Philippines (selected for 'preparatory discussions', Jun 2026 — which per ministers neither guarantee nor preclude an Accession Working Group); and China, Taiwan, Ecuador, Ukraine (applied 2021–2023, no process launched). Taiwan applied under the name 'Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu'.
Application months/years are from news and government reports and should be treated as approximate.

Did not find a Commission decision after the 26 Jun 2026 statement changing these statuses (searched 2026-11-16); the late-2026 Commission meeting under Viet Nam's chair could change Costa Rica's status.
